title: QUIC RFC 9000 Maximum ACK Delay Alarm Slack Policy Work Item
summary: Close the RFC 9000 Section 18.2 max_ack_delay alarm-delay policy gap by making the runtime default explicitly include expected alarm-firing delay and by adding focused requirement-home proof.
planned_changes:
- Add a centralized QuicMaxAckDelayPolicy that composes intentional ACK-delay budget with expected alarm-firing delay.
- Preserve the existing 25,000 microsecond default ACK-delay behavior while making the 1,000 microsecond alarm-firing component explicit.
- Retarget QuicConnectionRuntime's absent-local-parameter fallback to the policy default.
- Add focused S18P2-0015 requirement-home tests for default composition, absent-parameter ACK timer scheduling, explicit composed ACK timer scheduling, and saturating composition.
- Retarget REQ-QUIC-RFC9000-S18P2-0015 trace links away from broad transport-parameter codec tests.
verification_plan: Run a Release build, run the focused S18P2-0015 and S13P2P1 ACK-delay requirement-home filter, regenerate QUIC requirement coverage triage, validate SpecTrace JSON, run the full Release test suite without rebuilding, and check the resulting diff for whitespace errors.
out_of_scope: ACK delay exponent, RTT estimator, or PTO policy changes.
completion_notes: Completed as a focused runtime policy and requirement-home proof for REQ-QUIC-RFC9000-S18P2-0015.
